description: Check relevancy of one or more SAP Note numbers against this system (component/SP levels, download state, implementation readiness). Composite tool: classifies each note via the /classify_note_v2 gateway endpoint and aggregates the results. Notes that were never downloaded into SNOTE are reported with needs_download=true — run sap_download_note_v2 (requires OSS connectivity) or sap_upload_note_v2 first for a definitive verdict on those.
name: sap_check_notes_relevancy
